Class NamenodeProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocolPB.NamenodeProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.protocol.proto.NamenodeProtocolProtos.NamenodeProtocolService.BlockingInterface, NamenodeProtocolPB
public class NamenodeProtocolServerSideTranslatorPB extends Object implements NamenodeProtocolPB
Implementation for protobuf service that forwards requests received on NamenodeProtocolPB to the NamenodeProtocol server implementation.
